title: Ratio language and meaning
observableEvidence: Describes a ratio between two quantities in the requested order and explains what each quantity represents in context.
masteryCheckRule: Require two context-varied ratio descriptions with correct order and interpretation. Also require one independent, unassisted delayed check; assisted attempts alone do not establish secure mastery.

title: Rates and proportional reasoning
observableEvidence: Computes and interprets a unit rate, then uses equivalent ratios, tables, or equations to solve a proportional situation including percent or conversion contexts.
masteryCheckRule: Require one unit-rate item and one novel proportional application with a stated unit or context interpretation. Also require one independent, unassisted delayed check; assisted attempts alone do not establish secure mastery.

title: Division of fractions
observableEvidence: Models and computes division of fractions and explains the quotient in a measurement or sharing situation.
masteryCheckRule: Require a symbolic computation and a context problem, each with a checked quotient interpretation. Also require one independent, unassisted delayed check; assisted attempts alone do not establish secure mastery.

title: Multi-digit whole-number and decimal operations
observableEvidence: Accurately applies standard algorithms to multi-digit whole-number division and the four operations with multi-digit decimals, estimating to check reasonableness.
masteryCheckRule: Require one whole-number division and one decimal-operation item plus an estimate comparison. Also require one independent, unassisted delayed check; assisted attempts alone do not establish secure mastery.

title: Factors, multiples, and distributive structure
observableEvidence: Finds GCF and LCM of whole numbers up to 100, and uses the distributive property to express a sum of two whole numbers with a common factor as a multiple of a sum of two numbers with no common factor.
masteryCheckRule: Require independent GCF/LCM selection and a factored-sum explanation in a new pair of numbers. Also require one independent, unassisted delayed check; assisted attempts alone do not establish secure mastery.

title: Meaning of positive and negative rational numbers
observableEvidence: Interprets the sign and magnitude of a rational number in mathematical and real-world contexts and identifies its opposite.
masteryCheckRule: Require two signed-context interpretations and an opposite-number explanation. Also require one independent, unassisted delayed check; assisted attempts alone do not establish secure mastery.

title: Rational numbers on lines and planes
observableEvidence: Locates, orders, and compares rational numbers on a number line and identifies rational coordinates in a coordinate plane.
masteryCheckRule: Require a number-line ordering and a coordinate-plane placement with written comparison reasoning. Also require one independent, unassisted delayed check; assisted attempts alone do not establish secure mastery.

title: Operations with rational numbers
observableEvidence: Orders rational numbers, interprets absolute value as a number's distance from zero, and performs the four operations with rational numbers, explaining sign and magnitude using a model or property.
masteryCheckRule: Require one ordering task, one absolute-value-as-distance task, and two operation tasks with different signs, each with a reasonableness check. Also require one independent, unassisted delayed check; assisted attempts alone do not establish secure mastery.

title: Coordinate graphs and axis-parallel distance
observableEvidence: Graphs points in all four quadrants and finds horizontal or vertical distance from coordinate differences and absolute value.
masteryCheckRule: Require two axis-parallel distance problems in different quadrants and a coordinate-difference explanation. Also require one independent, unassisted delayed check; assisted attempts alone do not establish secure mastery.

title: Powers and whole-number exponents
observableEvidence: Writes and evaluates numerical expressions involving whole-number exponents, explaining the base, exponent, and repeated multiplication.
masteryCheckRule: Require writing a numerical expression with a whole-number exponent from a repeated-multiplication description and evaluating a given exponent expression, each explained. Also require one independent, unassisted delayed check; assisted attempts alone do not establish secure mastery.

title: Variables and expression evaluation
observableEvidence: Names parts of an expression, writes an expression from a context, and evaluates it for given variable values.
masteryCheckRule: Require context-to-expression and substitution tasks with distinct variable values. Also require one independent, unassisted delayed check; assisted attempts alone do not establish secure mastery.

title: Variables as quantities in context
observableEvidence: Uses a variable for an unknown or changing quantity, writes an expression for a real-world relationship, and explains the variable's possible values and meaning.
masteryCheckRule: Require two context models and a sentence identifying the variable and an appropriate value restriction. Also require one independent, unassisted delayed check; assisted attempts alone do not establish secure mastery.

title: Equivalent expressions and properties
observableEvidence: Uses properties to generate an equivalent expression and verifies equivalence by substitution or structural reasoning.
masteryCheckRule: Require a transformation and a verification of equivalence for an expression not seen in instruction. Also require one independent, unassisted delayed check; assisted attempts alone do not establish secure mastery.

title: Meaning of equations and inequalities
observableEvidence: Determines whether a value makes an equation or inequality true and explains solution as a value that satisfies the statement.
masteryCheckRule: Require truth-testing for one equation and one inequality plus a written meaning of solution. Also require one independent, unassisted delayed check; assisted attempts alone do not establish secure mastery.

title: One-variable equations
observableEvidence: Solves one-variable equations with nonnegative rational coefficients and checks the solution in the original equation.
masteryCheckRule: Require two equation structures and substitution checks, including a rational coefficient case. Also require one independent, unassisted delayed check; assisted attempts alone do not establish secure mastery.

title: Real-world inequalities
observableEvidence: Writes an inequality for a real-world constraint, tests candidate values, and graphs the solution set on a number line.
masteryCheckRule: Require a context-to-inequality model, a tested solution set, and a correctly labeled graph. Also require one independent, unassisted delayed check; assisted attempts alone do not establish secure mastery.

title: Two-variable relationships
observableEvidence: Identifies dependent and independent variables and represents a relationship with a table, graph, and equation.
masteryCheckRule: Require one context represented in all three forms and an explanation of variable roles. Also require one independent, unassisted delayed check; assisted attempts alone do not establish secure mastery.

title: Area by composing and decomposing polygons
observableEvidence: Finds the area of right triangles, other triangles, special quadrilaterals, and polygons by composing into rectangles or decomposing into triangles and other shapes in mathematical and real-world contexts.
masteryCheckRule: Require two decompositions of different polygons and units in the final area. Also require one independent, unassisted delayed check; assisted attempts alone do not establish secure mastery.

title: Volume of rectangular prisms with fractional edges
observableEvidence: Calculates the volume of a right rectangular prism with fractional edge lengths by packing it with unit cubes of appropriate unit fraction edge lengths and multiplying fractional dimensions.
masteryCheckRule: Require a fractional-edge computation and a context interpretation with cubic units. Also require one independent, unassisted delayed check; assisted attempts alone do not establish secure mastery.

title: Polygons and side lengths in the coordinate plane
observableEvidence: Draws a polygon from coordinates and determines horizontal or vertical side lengths using coordinate differences.
masteryCheckRule: Require a coordinate polygon with at least two axis-parallel sides and labeled lengths. Also require one independent, unassisted delayed check; assisted attempts alone do not establish secure mastery.

title: Nets and surface area
observableEvidence: Uses a net to identify all faces of a three-dimensional figure and finds total surface area in square units.
masteryCheckRule: Require a text-described or drawn net, a complete face inventory, and a square-unit total. Also require one independent, unassisted delayed check; assisted attempts alone do not establish secure mastery.

title: Statistical questions and variability
observableEvidence: Classifies questions by whether they anticipate variability and identifies the population or measurement context.
masteryCheckRule: Require classification of varied questions and revision of one non-statistical question. Also require one independent, unassisted delayed check; assisted attempts alone do not establish secure mastery.

title: Describing numerical distributions
observableEvidence: Displays numerical data in plots on a number line, including dot plots, histograms, and box plots, and describes the distribution's center, spread, overall shape, and real-world context.
masteryCheckRule: Require demonstrated use across all three representations (dot plot, histogram, and box plot) and a complete context sentence addressing center, spread, and shape. Also require one independent, unassisted delayed check; assisted attempts alone do not establish secure mastery.

title: Center and variability as summaries
observableEvidence: Chooses and computes measures of center and variability and uses them, with the number of observations and context, to summarize a numerical distribution.
masteryCheckRule: Require a full data summary naming context, number of observations, center, variability, and notable shape or outlier feature. Also require one independent, unassisted delayed check; assisted attempts alone do not establish secure mastery.
